Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is excited to move the pilot forward. Before we sign off on the technical kickoff, InfoSec asked for two quick things so we can slot this into our evaluation MAP: 

1) The filled security questionnaire (SOC 2 scope, CAIQ/SIG responses, data retention defaults).
2) A concise MAP that highlights the security/compliance gates and expected close timeline (we need this for procurement).

I attached the questionnaire (we used your template) and an initial procurement checklist. Could you please:
- Confirm SOC 2 scope (redwood-hosted vs dedicated options)
- Call out any data residency/retention controls and default retention windows
- Share timing for DPA review and your typical turnaround for redline responses

Target launch for the pilot in their QA environment is 2026-11-15 — InfoSec wants to know if that’s realistic given reviews.

Appreciate a short MAP by EOD Friday so I can update our stakeholders.

Best,

Elena — thanks for the clear ask and the deadline. Looping in Karthik (supporting Dedicated/Private deployment sizing) and Neha (security/compliance lead) to validate the MAP items.

Quick answers up front:
- SOC 2: Our hosted offering is SOC 2 Type II scoped for the inference and control plane. Dedicated customers can contract to include exclusive capacity; the evidence trail is identical for audit purposes — we’ll call out any operational differences in the MAP.
- Data retention: Default transient KV/cache retention is 48 hours; logs/usage events retained 90 days by default. We offer configurable retention tiers (30/90/365/never purge with DPA carveouts) for Dedicated/Private with customer-managed retention policy.
- DPA review: Typical redline turnaround is 3 business days for first pass; complex legal redlines can take up to 10 business days depending on scope.

I’ll draft a short MAP with explicit security gates (SOC 2 evidence handoff, SIG/CAIQ Q&A, DPA sign-off, retention config) and a proposed timeline to match your 2026-11-15 pilot target. Expect a MAP draft by Friday EOD.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Subject: MAP draft & acceptance gates — Firstline pilot (FL-8241)

Elena / Firstline team — attaching our concise MAP draft below (inline) and calling out the security gates that will determine whether the 2026-11-15 pilot date is achievable. Summary first, then the gate list and timelines.

SUMMARY (quick):
- Short answer: 2026-11-15 pilot start is feasible provided DPA is agreed within 2 weeks and InfoSec accepts our SOC 2 evidence and SIG clarifications within 10 business days.
- Critical path: DPA sign-off (Procurement) -> SIG/CAIQ clarifications (InfoSec) -> Evidence handoff (SOC 2 artifacts) -> Environment provisioning (ops) -> Pilot start.

SECURITY/COMPLIANCE GATES (MAP items):
1) DPA redline resolution (Procurement) — deliverable: redline response and counter; owner: Redwood legal + Firstline procurement; expected cadence: 3 business days for first pass, lock within 10 business days.
2) SIG/CAIQ Q&A — deliverable: annotated CAIQ with hosted vs dedicated notes; owner: Redwood security (Neha) + Firstline InfoSec; expected cadence: 5 business days after we receive the prioritized question list.
3) SOC 2 evidence handoff — deliverable: control descriptions + attestation excerpts (non-sensitive); owner: Redwood security; expected cadence: 3 business days to provide curated artifacts; Note: full audit reports provided under NDA only.
4) Data retention & escrow decision — deliverable: retention policy and (if needed) escrow statement; owner: Redwood legal + Ops; expected cadence: 5–7 business days depending on escrow complexity.
5) Environment provisioning & verification — deliverable: QA environment access + smoke test results; owner: Redwood Ops; expected cadence: 3 business days post DPA sign-off and acceptance of service config.

TIMELINE (proposed):
- 2026-10-04: Redwood returns DPA first-pass counters
- 2026-10-08: Firstline procurement responds or flags exceptions
- 2026-10-15: SIG/CAIQ Q&A completed (assuming prioritized list by 2026-10-05)
- 2026-10-18: SOC 2 artifacts delivered under NDA
- 2026-10-20: Retention/escrow decision finalized
- 2026-10-25: Ops provisions QA environment
- 2026-11-15: Pilot start (target)

RISKS/ASSUMPTIONS:
- If procurement requires an escrow for logs beyond our standard retention tiers, add 7–10 business days.
- Dedicated deployment reduces ambiguity on segregation but requires initial capacity reservation (lead time 5 business days once committed).

ATTACHMENTS: Firstline_Security_Questionnaire_v3.pdf (from you), DPA_redline_Firstline.docx (from you). We will upload our annotated CAIQ and DPA counters to the HubSpot deal and send a DocuSign link for signature.

NEXT STEPS (action items):
- Firstline: confirm prioritized SIG questions by 2026-10-05.
- Redwood: deliver DPA first-pass counters by 2026-10-04 (Priyom / Jonas)
- Redwood security: publish annotated CAIQ by 2026-10-08 (Neha)

If that cadence looks good I’ll open the HubSpot timeline and set a weekly touchpoint. Feel free to flag anything I’ve missed.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
